lines.en: label mollysummer2cafegen:
scene mollysummer2cafegen
I make my way to the cafe to hang out with Molly and immediately regret my decision as she sprays me with cleaning fluid and tells me that I have been purified.
lines.zh: 我去咖啡馆找 Molly 玩，结果立刻就后悔了这个决定——她拿清洁剂喷了我一身，还宣布我已经被净化了。

lines.en: Whatever strange sort of purification ritual this is, I doubt it works as my thoughts are just as cynical and self-serving as ever.
lines.zh: 不管这是什么奇怪的净化仪式，我怀疑它根本没用，因为我的念头还是一如既往地愤世嫉俗又自私自利。

lines.en: I am reminded of this when she sprays me {i}a second time{/i} because one purification simply wouldn’t be enough.
lines.zh: 她又喷了我{i}第二次{/i}，理由是净化一次根本不够，这让我更加确信了这一点。

lines.en: Thankfully, I am a large and powerful man who is able to snatch the bottle out of her hands and spray her back with it.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，我是个高大威猛的男人，一把从她手里夺过瓶子，反喷了回去。

lines.en: {i}Not{/i} so thankfully, I spray her directly in the face and have to spend the next five minutes washing her eyes out so she doesn’t go blind.
lines.zh: {i}不太妙{/i}的是，我直接喷到了她脸上，只好花接下来的五分钟给她冲洗眼睛，免得她瞎掉。

lines.en: But, if you ask me if I regret anything, I’ll tell you I don’t.
lines.zh: 不过，要是你问我后不后悔，我会告诉你：不后悔。

lines.en: In fact, I’d double down and say that she had this coming.
lines.zh: 事实上，我还要再加一句——她是自找的。

lines.en: But that’s okay-
Because now-
She, too, has been purified.
scene black
Molly regains her vision, but not her bottle as I have hidden it in a location that someone her size would never be able to reach.
lines.zh: Molly 恢复了视力，却没能拿回她的瓶子——我把它藏到了以她那个身高绝对够不着的地方。

lines.en: Feeling slightly bad about being the [[deserved] cause of her current ocular anguish, I accompany Molly back to the table and sit with her as her purification wears off.
lines.zh: 想到自己[[deserved]地造成了她此刻眼睛的痛苦，我稍微有点过意不去，于是陪 Molly 回到桌边，坐着等她的净化效果消退。

lines.en: I even take it upon myself to clean off a few tables in the process. Just...without the cleaning juice as I don’t want her to find out where I hid it.
lines.zh: 我还主动擦了几张桌子。只是……没用那种清洁液，因为我可不想让她发现我藏在哪儿。

lines.en: Eventually, Molly returns to normal and attempts to cast some sort of Gaelic spell on me or something with a magic wand that she had tucked into her back pocket for some reason.
lines.zh: 最后 Molly 总算恢复了正常，然后试图用一根不知为什么塞在她后裤兜里的魔杖，对我施放某种盖尔语咒语之类的东西。

lines.en: I take this as my cue to leave and do so without the effects of the spell ever reaching me.
lines.zh: 我把这当成该走人的信号，于是在咒语生效之前溜之大吉。

lines.en: But if I randomly drop dead one day due to unknown causes, you’ll know why.
lines.zh: 不过要是哪天我莫名其妙地暴毙，死因不明，你们就知道是怎么回事了。
